posts.name: EricAlexWTG
posts.cooked:
Had a great game against advanced Voss tonight. Tachyon, Haka, Bunker, and the Wraith. Wraith used her infrared eyepiece to hold off Forced Deployments until the villain trash was full to bursting. Finally, one of them hit the table. On Tachyon’s turn she destroyed the Forced Deployment. Sixteen minions marched dutifully onto the table, and Haka Rampaged them all to death instantly. One card, sixteen kills! Finally finished off Voss with a fully load Inventory Barrage for 20 damage on the dot. Got Welcome to Earth, Prepared for Martyrdom, and Powerhouse all at the same time!

My group still hasn’t beaten Dawn yet, though…

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
TheJayManm, Rabit, me, and five of our friends got together to play Sentinels today. We played eight total games. It might have been more if four of us didn’t end up in a very slow (fun, but S L O W) whittling of Citizen Dawn. Totally stoked to actually beat her after losing most of our hit points before doing virtually any damage to her. Three quarters of the team would have qualified for Last Man Standing. Playing the Wraith vs Dawn on Mars == lots of equipment loss.

One of the best parts of the day was facing Omnitron on standard mode and attempting to get a Flawless Victory. With both police backups as well as Bunker doing 2 pts of damage each turn, we actually contemplated trying to find a way to heal Omnitron to give us more time to heal ourselves. In the end, Omnitron got out both of the one-shots that cleared equipment and ongoing cards as well as doing a ton of damage. The heroes then realized it was time to stop show-boating and finish him off. We did, at least, let The Real Heroes do the destroying.
